request.raw_text: Hi , Please convert the round edges of the gear into straight spur gear teeth.

aim.primary_aim: Replace the gear's rounded edge geometry with straight spur gear teeth while preserving the remainder of the model.

functional_design_intentions.name: Spur-gear engagement
functional_design_intentions.description: Provide tooth geometry suitable for engagement as a spur gear; this function is inferred from the requested gear type.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: rounded edge or tooth geometry around the gear

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: all non-targeted gear and model geometry
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve all geometry and properties not required to replace the rounded gear-edge geometry with straight spur gear teeth.

geometry.description: The gear has straight spur gear teeth in place of the referenced rounded edge geometry.

functions.name: Spur-gear engagement
functions.description: The resulting tooth geometry supports engagement as a spur gear.

behaviors.name: Rotary transmission
behaviors.description: When paired with a compatible mating gear, the straight teeth engage to transmit rotary motion; this behavior is inferred from the requested spur-gear form.

validation_criteria.description: The referenced rounded gear-edge geometry is replaced by straight spur gear teeth.
The teeth are arranged around the gear circumference and are parallel to the gear axis, consistent with a spur gear.
The resulting tooth arrangement is consistent with spur-gear engagement.
The tooth geometry permits rotary engagement with a compatible mating spur gear.
Non-targeted gear and model geometry remains unchanged.

unresolved_requirements.description: The phrase "round edges of the gear" does not uniquely identify whether the target is a rounded outer perimeter, rounded tooth geometry, or edge fillets on existing teeth.
candidate_interpretations: Replace a rounded or scalloped outer perimeter with a complete set of spur gear teeth.
Replace existing rounded tooth profiles with straight spur gear tooth geometry.
Remove rounding or fillets from the edges of existing gear teeth.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request does not specify tooth count, module or pitch, pressure angle, face width, root geometry, tip geometry, or mating-gear requirements.
candidate_interpretations: Retain compatible existing gear dimensions and tooth-system properties wherever they can be resolved from the model.
Use a new spur-gear specification that must be supplied separately.

unresolved_requirements.description: The word "straight" may refer either to teeth parallel to the gear axis, as in a standard spur gear, or to literal straight-sided tooth profiles.
candidate_interpretations: Use standard spur gear teeth oriented parallel to the gear axis.
Use literal straight-sided teeth rather than standard curved tooth profiles.
